ext.connect.title: Connect this browser
ext.connect.sub: Sites shown in this browser count toward your PR.SOCIAL account. Connecting takes one click on the site.
ext.connect.wait: Confirm on the page that opened. The code expires in {time}.
ext.connect.fail: No connection to pr.social. Check your internet connection and try again.
ext.connect.no.tasks: A browser can be connected after {need} approved tasks. Complete tasks on pr.social, then confirm the connection again.
ext.connect.no.devices: Your account already has {max} devices connected. Disconnect one on pr.social in Tools, then confirm the connection again.
ext.connect.no.device: This browser cannot be connected. Automated browsers are not supported.
ext.connect.no.restricted: Your account is restricted. The browser can be connected once the restriction is lifted.
ext.connect.no.off: The Surfing extension is not available for your account yet.
ext.start.hint: The sites open in a window of their own. Keep it on the screen: you can make it small, put it in a corner and work in other windows. Minimised or fully covered, it pauses.
ext.perm.why: To show sites, the extension asks Chrome for permission to open any site in its own window. It does not use this permission for anything else.
ext.pause.hidden.sub: Showing will continue when the sites window is back on the screen.
ext.pause.locked.sub: Showing will continue automatically when the computer is unlocked.
ext.gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL has blocked this browser. Write to Support to find out why and what to do.
ext.gate.update.sub: This version no longer works. The button below opens the page of the new version and shows how to install it.
ext.gate.closed.sub: The extension checks on its own, so there is nothing you need to do.
ext.off.sub: It was removed from your account on pr.social. You can connect it again with a new code.
ext.limits.hour.hint: How many sites this browser can show in an hour
ext.money: Earnings reach your balance within a few minutes. Here they appear right away.
ext.stage.title: PR Surf window
ext.stage.sub: Sites open here by themselves. Keep this window on the screen: you can make it small, put it in a corner and work in other windows. Minimised or fully covered, it pauses. You can stop it in the extension.
ext.wait.offline.sub: Showing will continue by itself when the connection is back. Sites already shown are not lost.
ext.wait.empty.sub: New sites appear when advertisers order visits. The extension checks again at {time} by itself.
ext.pause.person.sub: Press Continue when you are ready.
ext.pause.closed.sub: Showing is paused until the window is open again. Sites already shown are not lost.
ext.pause.covered.sub: Sites count only while their window is visible. Showing will continue when it is back on the screen.
ext.pause.check_missed.sub: “Are you there?” was not answered in time. Press Continue to resume.
ext.check.sub: Press the button below to continue. Showing is paused until you answer.
ext.stopped.restart: Showing stopped when Chrome restarted. Start it again when you are ready.
ext.net.stale: No connection to pr.social. The numbers below may be out of date.
ext.why.CRASH: The page stopped responding, so the extension opened a new tab and moved on.
ext.why.SHORT: The page was not on the screen long enough. Keep the sites window open and visible.
ext.why.EARLY: The extension reported this site sooner than its viewing time allows. Keep the date and time on your computer set automatically.
ext.why.GONE: The extension reported this site too late: showing was interrupted for a long time.
ext.why.BLOCKED: The site's protection did not let the extension open the page.
ext.why.TIMEOUT: The site took too long to load. It may be slow, or the connection may be weak.
ext.update.ready: A new version of PR Surf is out. This one keeps working for now.
